cases.name: Dawn Nancy Longo Rowe
cases.about: Her obituary said Dawn had many interests, some of which included her love of travel, music and her precious feline babies. Dawn's life was shorter than we would have chosen it to be, but the impact of her life on those who worked with her and loved her will last forever.
